bullets.id: CPI September AS naik 0,6% sebulan dan 3,7% setahun, di atas konsensus 3,6% dan naik dari 3,4% pada Agustus; inflasi inti 2,6% (perkiraan 2,5%). Bensin melonjak 9,1% dan menyumbang lebih dari separuh kenaikan bulanan. Emas spot jatuh 2% ke $4.075,10 pada siang hari AS dan perak anjlok sekitar 6%, lalu emas pulih ke sekitar $4.152 pada Kamis pagi waktu Asia.
bullets.en: US September CPI rose 0.6% on the month and 3.7% on the year, above the 3.6% consensus and up from 3.4% in August; core inflation was 2.6% (2.5% expected). Gasoline jumped 9.1% and drove more than half of the monthly gain. Spot gold fell 2% to $4,075.10 by midday in the US and silver dropped about 6%, before gold recovered to about $4,152 on Thursday morning in Asia.

bullets.id: Peluang kenaikan suku bunga Fed pada 28 Oktober di CME FedWatch melonjak ke sekitar 50% dari sekitar 24% sehari sebelumnya. Indeks dolar naik 0,7% ke 102,86 dan yield 10 tahun menyentuh kisaran 5,18%–5,33%. Pemulihan Kamis terjadi karena reli minyak lima hari terhenti serta dolar dan yield mundur. Emas masih turun sekitar 2,6% sebulan dan sekitar 26% di bawah rekor Januari $5.608.
bullets.en: CME FedWatch odds of a Fed hike on October 28 jumped to about 50% from about 24% the day before. The dollar index rose 0.7% to 102.86 and the 10-year yield traded in a 5.18%–5.33% range. Thursday’s recovery came as oil’s five-day rally stalled and the dollar and yields eased. Gold is still down about 2.6% on the month and about 26% below its January record of $5,608.

bullets.id: Kitco menandai resistance di $4.114, lalu zona $4.134,62–$4.141,97, $4.167,62 dan $4.217,40. Support di $4.072,70 dan $4.066,54; jika tembus, target berikutnya $4.004,68. Kamis malam pasar menunggu PPI September, penjualan ritel dan klaim pengangguran mingguan AS, lalu harga impor dan produksi industri pada Jumat.
bullets.en: Kitco marks resistance at $4,114, then the $4,134.62–$4,141.97 zone, $4,167.62 and $4,217.40. Support sits at $4,072.70 and $4,066.54; a break would target $4,004.68. On Thursday evening the market awaits US September PPI, retail sales and weekly jobless claims, then import prices and industrial production on Friday.

bullets.id: Antam turun Rp13.000 ke Rp2.561.000/gram dengan buyback Rp2.370.000, spread Rp191.000 (sekitar 7,5%). Galeri24 Rp2.516.000 (buyback Rp2.370.000), Rp45.000 lebih murah dari Antam, dan UBS Rp2.539.000 (buyback Rp2.344.000). Beige Book Fed mencatat kenaikan harga yang makin cepat di empat distrik, tanda tekanan inflasi yang menjadi fokus pasar emas.
bullets.en: Antam fell Rp13,000 to Rp2,561,000/gram with a Rp2,370,000 buyback, a Rp191,000 spread (about 7.5%). Galeri24 is at Rp2,516,000 (buyback Rp2,370,000), Rp45,000 cheaper than Antam, and UBS at Rp2,539,000 (buyback Rp2,344,000). The Fed’s Beige Book noted accelerating price increases in four districts, a sign of the inflation pressure the gold market is focused on.
